satellite.heading: Satellite
satellite.specs:
Dimensions: 5 cm cube (5 × 5 × 30 cm with the antenna deployed)
1P PocketQube
Weight: 250 g
Materials: aluminum, gold, fiberglass, and electronic components.
Orbit: sun-synchronous, about 500 to 560 km; inclination about 97.5°
Launch: SpaceX Transporter-18, Vandenberg, October 1, 2026

antenna.heading: Antenna/Sculpture
antenna.specs:
Dimensions: 6 m (diameter) e 1.2m (height)
Weight: 46 kg
Materials: aluminum, epoxy mirrored board, golden aluminum dome suspended through a scaffolding structure.
Status: designed

radio.heading: Radio Specs
radio.specs:
Uplink: 401.5 MHz
Downlink: 468.5 MHz
Modulation: CSS
Status: in orbit since the launch on Transporter-18, October 1, 2026
